package_info.package_name: ROBUX-FREE-GENERATOR-NEWwhuycqy (example, applies to all similar spam packages)
package_info.why_malicious: The entire package is considered malicious because it is designed to lure users to phishing and scam domains via README links, with the intent to harvest credentials or personal information under the guise of 'free Robux' or 'Fortnite skins'. The packages contain no functional code and exist solely to promote scam websites.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: [FREE ROBUX ROBLOX GENERATOR 2022] How to get Roblox Free Robux Promo Codes Generator 2022 no Human Verification VISIT HERE https://freerobux.best ...
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When the package is viewed on the registry or installed, the README displays a link to a scam domain, enticing users to visit a phishing site that claims to offer free Robux or in-game items.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The README contains links to known scam/phishing domains and makes fraudulent claims about free in-game currency, a common lure for credential harvesting.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal package READMEs provide documentation or usage instructions, not links to external scam sites or misleading offers.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate packages may link to official documentation or project websites, but not to unrelated or scam domains.
key_indicators: README contains external links to non-official, suspicious domains
Fraudulent claims of free in-game currency or items
No functional code in the package

attack_chain.action: User discovers or installs the package and views the README.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is enticed to click the scam link.

attack_chain.action: User clicks the link and is redirected to a phishing or scam website.
attack_chain.leads_to: User may enter credentials or personal information, leading to credential theft or further scams.

behavioral_signatures: Packages with README files containing links to known scam or phishing domains
Packages with no functional code but containing promotional or misleading content
Packages making claims about free in-game currency or items
file_indicators: README.md containing URLs to domains such as freerobux.best, gamedip.xyz, gamemasters.xyz
Absence of source code files or legitimate package content
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests to freerobux.best, gamedip.xyz, gamemasters.xyz, or similar domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan package README and documentation files for links to known scam or phishing domains, especially those making offers of free in-game currency or items. Flag packages with no functional code and only promotional content. Monitor for new packages with similar naming patterns (e.g., 'robux', 'free', 'generator', 'fortnite', 'skins') and check for external links in their metadata.
